method.system_prompt:
You help the operator of an online store answer questions about their business.
Use the store's tools to find the answer; never guess or estimate a figure the
tools can give you. Answer the question that was asked, in a sentence or two.
method.answer_instruction:
When you have the answer, end your reply with a single line containing only a
JSON object of the form {"answer": <value>}, where <value> is the number or
name that answers the question (a number without currency symbols or units).
method.redaction: Customer-written review title/message in stored tool results and final answers is replaced with a length placeholder. Grading used the unredacted run; verdicts and metrics are unchanged.

questions.prompt: How many orders has the store received in total, counting every order whatever its status?
questions.risk: placed orders (search_orders) vs completed orders (revenue_report counts only completed)
questions.arg_rule: search_orders with no status, date, state, total, lateness or review filter

questions.prompt: How many orders placed in 2018 were cancelled?
questions.risk: status filter plus a year window on the tool that covers every status
questions.arg_rule: search_orders with status canceled, from 2018-01-01, and to absent or on/after 2018-10-17 (the last purchase date)

questions.prompt: What was the store's revenue in November 2017?
questions.risk: revenue here means gross revenue (items plus freight), not merchandise alone
questions.arg_rule: revenue_report grouped by month (or default), with any date window that covers all of November 2017

questions.prompt: Which product category brought in the most revenue?
questions.risk: two tools report category revenue; both rank the same category first
questions.arg_rule: revenue_report grouped by category with no date window, or list_categories sorted by revenue (or default)

questions.prompt: How much did the Health Beauty category sell in merchandise alone, not counting shipping?
questions.risk: item revenue vs gross revenue for a category; which tool exposes which
questions.arg_rule: list_categories, or revenue_report grouped by category with no date window

questions.prompt: Which seller has the highest sales revenue? Give their seller id.
questions.risk: seller revenue in two tools; item-level allocation ranks the same seller first either way
questions.arg_rule: seller_performance sorted by revenue (or default), or revenue_report grouped by seller with no date window

questions.prompt: How much was paid by credit card for orders placed in 2018?
questions.risk: payment-method breakdown (payment value) within a date window
questions.arg_rule: revenue_report grouped by payment_method, from 2018-01-01, and to absent or on/after 2018-10-17

questions.prompt: What is the average review score for orders that were delivered more than a week late?
questions.risk: delivery lateness bands and their review average
questions.arg_rule: delivery_performance grouped by lateness band (or default), with no date window

questions.prompt: What percentage of delivered orders arrived after their estimated delivery date?
questions.risk: the tool gives per-band rates; the overall rate needs combining bands by order count
questions.arg_rule: delivery_performance grouped by lateness band (or default), with no date window

questions.prompt: Among customer states with at least 500 delivered orders, which has the lowest average review score?
questions.risk: delivery population by state, with a minimum-order threshold

questions.prompt: What is the lifetime value of the customer 000bfa1d2f1a41876493be685390d6d3@olist.invalid?
questions.risk: exact customer lookup; lifetime value over completed orders
questions.arg_rule: find_customer with exactly that email (any case)

questions.prompt: What review score did order OL000087289 receive?
questions.risk: single-order lookup where the order has two reviews and the policy decides

questions.prompt: How many units of the product with SKU aca2eb7d00ea1a7b8ebd4e68314663af have been sold?
questions.risk: product lookup by SKU; units over completed orders
questions.arg_rule: get_product with that SKU, or search_products with that SKU as the query

questions.prompt: Among sellers with at least 100 orders, which has the worst average review score? Give their seller id.
questions.risk: seller_performance (completed orders) is the seller tool; delivery_performance by seller is a different population
questions.arg_rule: seller_performance sorted by avg_review, with min_orders 100

questions.prompt: How many orders from customers in Sao Paulo state were worth R$1,000 or more?
questions.risk: two search filters combined (state code SP, inclusive minimum total)
questions.arg_rule: search_orders with customer_state SP and min_total 1000
